name: Brasswork
feature_notes: The Engine Room opens with an illustrated machinery panel and large number keys. Type your PIN and press Enter, tap the keys and Unlock Engine Room, or switch between the two. Backspace or Delete removes the last digit. Clear or Escape starts over.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: At the Engine Room entrance, try entering some digits by touch and some with your keyboard. Use Backspace to correct a digit and press Enter to verify. Confirm the installed build after entry.
